text: 'Yellow school bus': concept art, 1 designs to choose from, then up to 1 rounds of notes

concept: A LEGO model of a chunky yellow school bus built from stacked bricks and plates, with a rounded roof, black-and-white striped bumpers, and four rolling wheels. (changed: Removed opening doors and moving parts since the build system favors fixed sub-assemblies; Simplified window shapes to flat tiles in a strip instead of individually framed windows)
drawing the concept as an official LEGO set
reading the concept and writing the build brief
turning the concept to see its side and back
comparing the renders with the concept

score 2/10: Does not read as a school bus at a glance - looks like a lumpy yellow block/train car; Windows are solid white tiles instead of dark transparent/black glazing, only 2 windows per side vs 4; Roof is a jumble of exposed studs and random raised plates instead of the smooth ribbed curved roof
reworking the design from the critic's notes
comparing the renders with the concept

score 3/10: Proportions far too long and low — concept is a short, stubby chunky bus, render is a stretched van/tram shape; Wheels tiny, half-buried and barely visible; concept has big chunky black tyres with grey hubs standing proud; Body colour is pale cream/light yellow instead of bright school-bus yellow
